## Featured Projects

### [Brazilian Peppertree Biological Control Mapping](brazilian-peppertree.qmd)

RStudio maps and GIS workflows used to track biological control releases, damage sightings, and establishment patterns across Florida.

**Skills:** R, GIS, ecological monitoring, spatial data cleaning, invasive species research

Spatial and statistical analysis of green infrastructure, urban heat, flooding, and socioeconomic variables.

**Skills:** ArcGIS Pro, R, regression, raster/vector analysis, environmental data visualization

### [USDA SARE Soil Health Research](soil-health.qmd)

Sustainable agriculture research involving soil health, compost samples, beneficial microorganisms, and grower outreach.
